listing.name: Scribblefarer
listing.summary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like version of Starfarer with hand-drawn style ships and weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a cartoony, kid-like version of Starfarer with hand-drawn style ships and weapons.

description:
So, I was thinking, Why not make a cartoony version of starfarer? Were guns go Pew pew and ships go Boom? Why not make it all kid like, as though it was all from the back of a 12 year old's notebook? Well, Why not? So here we go :D

=PROGRESS REPORT=

All goes well, Currently creating the .ship files, the Variant files, The sprites, the weapons and all of the mission integration, Estimated release of test version will be on Friday 6th :)

=TO DO LIST=

Possible Campaign integrationMore missionsBattle the evil Mendocians!Tons more ships are needed8-Bit music Adjustment of the AI to avoid retreating
